data.body: Cause triage (2026-11-21 PST, run 44681457334 tracebacks read against origin/main 1a11014a3a4); no fix started, ticket left open. Product defects found: (1) src/rebar/_store/git_locking.py:34-37,191 makes the store git advisory lock (bug 9305) a no-op where fcntl is absent, although src/rebar/_store/lock_kernel.py already has the msvcrt leg (take_exclusive/release_exclusive/is_contention); test_git_contention_9305's holder also imports fcntl. (2) src/rebar/_proc.py reap_process_group only proc.kill()s on non-POSIX (killpg is POSIX-only, harness.py:174-175 sets start_new_session only on posix), so on Windows a grounding tool's pipe-holding grandchild survives a timeout; test_harness's reproduction uses os.fork and should use a Popen grandchild. Test-side or POSIX-only: test_compact_trigger_shared_sidecars.py:106 and test_recent_creates_shared_journal.py:151 call select.select on a pipe (WinError 10038), replace with a bounded reader thread; test_gate_admission_09da.py:293 uses signal.SIGKILL, use proc.kill(); doctor_locks' contended-leg test holds with fcntl in its child, use lock_kernel; test_footprint and test_tracker_footprint_cli expect st_blocks allocation, while src/rebar/_store/footprint.py:26,70 deliberately reports unavailable (expect that on Windows); peak RSS is None without resource (src/rebar/llm/peak_rss.py:40), decide: product Windows measure (GetProcessMemoryInfo via ctypes) or expect None; test_opcert_producer_seam (0o600) and test_opcert_own_pub_resolution (read-only dir) and test_ensure_pandoc (exec bit) rely on POSIX mode bits: skip with reason, and file a bug that the op-cert private key gets no ACL restriction on Windows; test_snapshot_janitor open-reader eviction: os.rename of a directory with an open file fails on Windows, so janitor.py:211-214 returns 0 and leaves the entry (needs a decision: Windows eviction cannot be rename-first).
